hero.title: Command the fleet, stay in the dark
hero.body: Your AI agents are already a fleet: trading, buying, negotiating, paying. Midnight Armada is the private command deck that funds them, governs them and shields them, so thousands of autonomous agents can work in unison without exposing a single line of your enterprise data.

manifesto.quote: In the physical world, an armada is a fleet of warships working in perfect, disciplined unison. In the digital economy, your AI agents are your fleet.
manifesto.follow: They execute tasks, trade assets and conduct business at a speed no treasury team can watch. Armada gives every one of them orders, a budget and a line it cannot cross, and keeps the whole formation out of sight.

fleet.name: The Flagship
fleet.body: Your corporate treasury, held under multi-signature command. Policies are written here, compliance keys live here, and no order reaches the fleet without the Flagship's seal.
points: Multi-signature treasury for people and agents
Fleet-wide policies set in one place
Top-level compliance keys, never shared downstream

fleet.name: The Flotilla
fleet.body: Restricted wallets for clusters of agents: the marketing flotilla, the arbitrage flotilla, the procurement flotilla. Each sails under its own budget, its own whitelist and its own rules of engagement.
points: Budgets per flotilla, caps per agent
Sessions that expire when the mission does

fleet.name: Safe Harbor
fleet.body: Where idle assets rest between missions. Park treasury reserves to earn yield or stake on the Midnight network, and recall them to the fleet the moment an opportunity appears.

fleet.name: Cloaking Device
fleet.body: Selective disclosure for every transaction. Your agents prove to auditors and regulators that they followed the rules, without revealing how much moved, where it went or who they are.
points: Proof of compliance without the payload
Disclosure keys you issue, and revoke

watch.title: Orders
watch.body: The Flagship sets the mission: its budget, its counterparties, its limits and its deadline.

watch.title: Underway
watch.body: Flotillas execute in parallel. Every spend is checked against its orders before it is signed, and the chain checks it again.

watch.title: Report
watch.body: Results return to the Flagship as proofs, not logs. Auditors see that the rules held; competitors see nothing.

cloak.title: Proven compliant, never exposed
cloak.body: Most ledgers force a choice between transparency and privacy. Midnight's selective disclosure removes it: each transaction carries a proof that it met your policy, and the details stay sealed until you choose to open them.

rules.title: Quorums
rules.body: Large orders need several keys: two officers, or an officer and an agent that checks the work.

rules.title: Caps and horizons
rules.body: Every agent carries a ceiling per trade, per day and per mission, enforced where no software can argue.

rules.title: Blockades
rules.body: Counterparties the fleet may never pay, applied to every flotilla at once.

rules.title: Recall
rules.body: One order halts a flotilla or the whole fleet. Assets sail home to the Flagship.

commanders.title: Trading desks
commanders.body: Run arbitrage agents across venues without broadcasting your positions to the market.

commanders.title: Enterprises
commanders.body: Let procurement and finance agents pay suppliers inside approved budgets, with an audit trail regulators accept.

commanders.title: Studios and platforms
commanders.body: Fund the agents that live in your worlds and marketplaces, and keep their economies fair.

commanders.title: Funds and DAOs
commanders.body: Delegate treasury work to agents under quorum control, without publishing who holds which mandate.

scale.label: bytes of enterprise data on the public chain

commission.title: Commission your fleet
commission.body: Midnight Armada is being prepared for service. Tell us about your fleet and we will be in touch as the first commissions open.
commission.note: This is a preview. The form does not send anything yet.

deck.title: The command deck
deck.body: One board for the whole fleet: what every flotilla holds, what it has spent against its orders, and every settlement it made, cloaked and proven.

course.body: The fleet sails on Midnight's test networks: flagship, flotillas and cloak under real load.
A handful of enterprises take command, with shared control for people and agents from day one.
Safe Harbor opens to staking and yield, and flotillas reach the services built across the Midnight network.
Fleets of tens of thousands, cooperating across organisations, each still dark to the others.
